title: Ensuring Credibility of Carbon Products to be Traded through Singapore
what_it_is: Ensuring Credibility of Carbon Products to be Traded through Singapore

sections.label: Singapore carbon services hub
sections.summary: Under the Singapore Green Plan 2030, Singapore aims to be a leading carbon services and trading hub to create green business opportunities and jobs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: As announced under the Singapore Green Plan 2030, Singapore aims to be a leading carbon services and trading hub, as we seek to create new business opportunities and jobs in the green sector for Singaporeans.

sections.label: Carbon credit quality guidelines
sections.summary: Singapore is developing a taxonomy and guidelines on the quality of carbon credits.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: First, we are developing a taxonomy and guidelines on the quality of these carbon credits.

sections.label: Pavilion Energy carbon-neutral LNG cargo
sections.summary: Pavilion Energy imported Singapore's first carbon-neutral liquefied natural gas cargo in April 2021, requiring suppliers to state each cargo's greenhouse gas emissions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Pavilion Energy has announced that it had imported the first carbon-neutral liquefied natural gas cargo into Singapore in April 2021.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Under this commercial arrangement, Pavilion Energy required its suppliers to provide a statement of greenhouse gas emissions of each cargo, measured from the production of the gas to the delivery to end-users in Singapore.

sections.label: Compliance and voluntary carbon markets
sections.summary: There are two broad categories of carbon markets, compliance and voluntary, regulated by mandatory national, regional or international carbon reduction regimes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Suffice to say – I hope I am not over-simplifying them – that, broadly, there are two broad categories.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: They are the compliance markets and then you have the voluntary markets.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: They are regulated by mandatory national, regional or international carbon reduction regimes.

sections.label: Voluntary carbon markets
sections.summary: The markets shared with Members earlier are voluntary markets.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: On the other hand, what I have shared with Members earlier on are voluntary markets.

sections.label: Working with groups on strategy
sections.summary: Work is ongoing with different groups to nuance the approach, articulate and communicate the strategy, and educate companies to embark on the roadmap.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: At our end, we have actually been working with the different groups to see how we can nuance this approach and the key thing is to articulate and communicate this strategy and also educate many more of our companies to embark on this roadmap and to come onto this platform with us.
